# One-hot encode categorical columns and align train/test features
train_df = pd.get_dummies(train_df)

# Align columns: ensure train and test have the same columns
train_cols = train_df.columns
test_cols = test_df.columns

# Add missing columns in test with 0 values
for col in train_cols:
    if col not in test_cols:
        test_df[col] = 0

# Remove extra columns in test that aren't in train
for col in test_cols:
    if col not in train_cols:
        test_df = test_df.drop(col, axis=1)

# Reorder test columns to match train order
